title: S3 bucket allows anonymous access
description: The S3 bucket acme-exports-public has a bucket policy that grants anonymous access to unauthenticated users. The bucket is publicly readable and its contents can be listed by anyone.

title: Instance credentials used outside AWS
description: The IAM credentials belonging to user svc-backup were used to call AWS APIs from an external network. Instance credentials are expected to be used only from inside the account's own instances.

title: Console login without MFA
description: User svc-backup signed in to the AWS Management Console from a new location without multi-factor authentication. The account policy requires MFA for console access.

title: Port probe against EC2 instance
description: The EC2 instance i-0b1c2d3e4f5061728 was probed on port 8080 by an external scanner. A single probe is often background internet noise.

title: Bitcoin mining activity on EC2 instance
description: The EC2 instance i-0f7a2b9c41d3e5f60 queried the domain pool.bitminers.example, which is associated with a known Bitcoin mining pool. DNS activity of this kind is consistent with cryptocurrency mining running on the instance.

title: Instance communicating with a malicious IP
description: The EC2 instance i-0f7a2b9c41d3e5f60 communicated with 203.0.113.77, an IP address on the account threat list. Instances do not normally communicate with addresses on this list.
